meta.source: Derived from the Phosphor system; hue swapped to ultraviolet

color.note: One theme. Plugins live inside Ableton's dark session view and never follow the host theme. Data colours (spec-*, plot-*) colour pictures of a signal and nothing else: never a control, a panel or text.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Window ground: the plugin's outermost surface. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: bg-dot
tokens.usage: The dot of the dot-paper pattern on the window ground: 1px dots at a 12px (space-3) pitch, under a 5% uv-deep uniform noise. Grows, brightens and gains grain on a Ground wave peak. Only on the window ground, never inside a panel or well.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panel: a grouped section of controls inside the window (envelope, sequencer).

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Control well: knob disc, slider rail bed, select field, a step that is off.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Raised well: a well on hover, a pressed button's ground, a list row under the pointer.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline: dividers between panels and around wells. Decorative, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Rail: the unlit part of a knob arc or slider track. Marks range, not value.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: values, readouts, titles. Near-white with a violet cast. On bg-000 to bg-300 (15:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: parameter labels, units, the hint bar. On bg-000 to bg-300 (8:1+).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Disabled text and inactive marks (ring segments, tick marks). Not for running text: 3.1:1 on bg-300, use at 12px+ bold or for marks only.

tokens.name: uv
tokens.usage: The signal, as near-white violet: lit steps, value arcs (and the detent tick a value sits on), LED, focus, primary button fill. It is the bright core; the violet lives in its halo (uv-deep).

tokens.name: uv-deep
tokens.usage: The saturated violet. Never a fill on its own: it is the glow around every lit uv element (glow-led, arc and fill drop-shadows) and the tint of the ground noise.

tokens.name: uv-glow
tokens.usage: Halo around a lit element (uv-deep at 50%): LED, lit and playhead steps, focus. Alpha only; never a fill.

tokens.name: on-uv
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a uv fill (primary button, a lit icon button, a lit step's index): deep ultraviolet, uv-deep's hue darkened, 7.0:1 on uv, so a lit control keeps its violet in its own letters. Never on red: the record button's glyph on its red fill is bg-000 (on-uv on red is 2.6:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning state: record armed, clipping about to happen, an unsaved patch. Small marks only, at most one per window.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error/clip: a meter past 0 dB, a failed paste. Never decorative.

tokens.name: spec-0
tokens.usage: Spectrogram ramp, stop 0 of 5: silence. The value of bg-000, so a silent spectrogram is the window's own ground. The five stops are one sequence, sampled between by magnitude; a stop means a position on the ramp, not a colour of its own. Data colour: only in a picture of a signal.

tokens.name: spec-1
tokens.usage: Spectrogram ramp, stop 1: the quietest band that shows. The value of bg-dot. Data colour.

tokens.name: spec-2
tokens.usage: Spectrogram ramp, stop 2: the middle of the range. The one stop that appears nowhere else in the system. Data colour.

tokens.name: spec-3
tokens.usage: Spectrogram ramp, stop 3: loud. The value of uv-deep, here as data rather than light: uv-deep's never-a-fill rule governs the interface, and the ramp is a picture of sound.

tokens.name: spec-4
tokens.usage: Spectrogram ramp, stop 4: the loudest band, at full scale. The value of uv, so the loudest part of the picture is lit in the system's own signal.

tokens.name: plot-fill
tokens.usage: The area under a curve in a PlotWell (an envelope, the gate across one cycle). The value of bg-300, so the curve's own 2px uv line is the only light in the well. Data colour.

tokens.name: plot-ghost
tokens.usage: A reference curve behind the one that plays, 1px: the envelope as dialled behind what the gate leaves of it. The value of line-200, a rail: it marks what could be, not what is. Data colour, only in a PlotWell.

tokens.name: plot-dry
tokens.usage: The dry input behind a processed trace, at half opacity under the uv one. Deliberately achromatic, the one grey in the system, so it reads as 'not the signal': the violet is what the plugin did, the grey is what came in. Data colour, only in a PlotWell.

type.note: One family, monospace, loaded from Google Fonts (previews) or bundled with the plugin (JetBrains Mono, OFL). Digits must be tabular: a readout must not jitter while a knob turns.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The one big number a plugin is about (step count, BPM, dB). ink on bg-000.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Plugin or panel name, uppercase. ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Parameter label above a knob or slider, uppercase. ink-muted.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Value readout under a control, select text, list rows. ink.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button text. ink, or on-uv on a primary button.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: The hint bar at the bottom of a window, and a PlotWell's caption. ink-muted, with the verb or an info string's name in ink.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Controls snap to it; the knob (48) and step (40) are multiples.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a rail and its bed; LED to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between steps in a grid; label to control; padding inside a readout.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and selects.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between control groups (envelope, gate).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Window padding; gap between the big readout and the control block.

radius.note: Square by default. Round only what physically turns.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, wells, buttons, steps, readouts, selects. The default.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Slider thumb, LED housing, the caret in a select. The only softening allowed on a rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Knob discs, LED lens, ring segments' end caps.

shadow.note: No drop shadows: nothing floats. The only shadow is light, and the light is violet around a white core.

tokens.name: glow-led
tokens.usage: Halo on every lit element: LED on, a lit step, the playhead, a primary button.

tokens.name: glow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on any control.

size.note: Control sizes, in px. Keep them: a plugin is a machine, and its knobs are all the same knob.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Knob disc diameter, label above, readout below.

tokens.name: knob-lg
tokens.usage: One larger knob per window at most, for the parameter the plugin is about.

tokens.name: step
tokens.usage: Sequencer step, square.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, selects and readouts.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Knob arc and slider track stroke.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border.

tokens.name: stroke-rail
tokens.usage: Knob arc, slider track, ring segments.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers.
